text: Aabria Iyengar (née Lipscomb; born May 11, 1985) is an American web series actress known primarily for tabletop role-playing game anthologies, streams, and podcasts. She is one of the creator-owners of the actual play podcast Worlds Beyond Number, which premiered in March 2023 and ranked in Patreon's top twenty accounts within a month. Iyengar served as the Dungeon Master (DM) for the first season of Exandria Unlimited and was the DM for two actual play anthology web series in 2021: Misfits and Magic (the tenth season of Dimension 20) and the first season of Exandria Unlimited, making her the first Critical Role DM after Matthew Mercer outside of one-shots. She has been both a player and a Game Master for multiple seasons of Dimension 20 and a guest DM on The Adventure Zone. Iyengar joined the main cast of Critical Role as a player in the fourth campaign, which premiered in October 2025, and also joined the third campaign as a guest star playing as gnome cleric Deanna in March 2023. In November 2023, she became the game master for the third chapter of Candela Obscura. She returned to Dimension 20 as the gamemaster for Burrow's End in 2023 and for the second season of Misfits and Magic in 2024, the first Side Quest campaign to receive a sequel season. In 2022, she appeared as gamemaster on Dimension 20: A Court of Fey & Flowers and joined the cast of the Vampire: The Masquerade web series NY by Night, playing as Margot "Fuego" Walker. In 2025, she reprised her player role in The Twenty-Sided Tavern and acted as the show's first guest Dungeon Master, also guest starring during the U.S. national tour in Chicago. Following a delay in filming the third season of NY by Night, Iyengar and other cast members formed Project Ghostlight to create independent, non-official World of Darkness actual plays; she stars in Private Nightmares, the group's first show, which premiered in March 2025. Iyengar contributed to the Critical Role sourcebook Tal'Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn (2022) and wrote a short story in the anthology Critical Role: Vox Machina–Stories Untold (2025). She is the writer, with artist Mari Costa, on the comic series The Fade, with the first issue published by Boom! Studios in November 2024. Born Aabria Lipscomb on May 11, 1985, she attended the University of Iowa, where she was a member of their Division I volleyball team, and the University of California, Los Angeles, where she competed for the UCLA Bruins track and field team. Iyengar first played Dungeons & Dragons in 2015 or 2016 when invited to her now husband's board game group and was given a cleric character sheet to play. Wired noted that she was often the only woman or person of color at the table and faced questioning and harassment, which she now addresses as a DM to ensure players do not face similar challenges. In April 2023, WizKids announced a new miniature boxed set of Exandria Unlimited characters including a figurine of Iyengar. She also appeared as both a player and as the Dungeon Master in multiple actual play podcasts between 2018 and 2020 on the Happy Jack's RPG Network. Iyengar was originally a guest player, acting as Laura Bennett, in the actual play web series Kollok: 1991 on the Hyper RPG Twitch channel before joining the main cast in the second season in 2019. In 2022, she reprised her role in the sequel set 30 years after the first show – Kollok was broadcast on AMC Networks' FearHQ Twitch channel. Iyengar has been part of the main cast, playing as Koseh, for Into the Mother Lands since 2020. She was the former chief marketing officer for the dice-maker Dice Envy. In Game Changer's seventh season, Vic Michaelis and Iyengar were elected as honorary presidents of Dropout. Chase Carter of Dicebreaker stated that both of her 2021 appearances were hits, leading many to clamor for more, and Christian Hoffer of ComicBook.com highlighted her fantastic storytelling and rapport with players. Carter also noted that Iyengar has become a household name in tabletop actual play, with her fame being a welcome change as a Black woman gaining respect and excitement in a historically white hobby. Iyengar gave the Storytime keynote at the 2021 PAX Unplugged. She also participated in Roll20 series using the Strixhaven: A Curriculum of Chaos module, appeared in vignette mini-episodes and spin-off one-shots, and contributed to a Patreon exclusive prequel podcast for The Wizard, the Witch, and the Wild One. All of these are Patreon exclusive.
